settings.title: Shipping
settings.text: We ship pan-India. Orders are typically packed and handed to our courier partner within 1-2 business days; delivery timelines depend on your location and are shown at checkout.

settings.title: Returns
settings.text: As this is a food product, we're unable to accept returns once a pack has been opened. If anything arrives damaged, incorrect, or expired, contact us within 48 hours of delivery and we'll sort it out.

settings.title: Order support
settings.text: Questions about an order in transit, or anything else? Reach out via our contact page and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
